name: Axon Server
tagline: AxonIQ's event store and message router for Axon Framework CQRS and event-sourced apps.
description: Axon Server combines an event store with a router for commands, events and queries, designed to back applications built on the Java Axon Framework. It removes the need for a separate message broker in CQRS systems, providing location-transparent routing, event streaming and snapshots. Since 2023 it ships as one artifact whose capabilities depend on the license present; the 2026.x line added Dynamic Consistency Boundary (DCB) event stores, learner nodes and Java 21 as minimum. Free use is limited, with clustering, multi-context and production use generally under AxonIQ's paid plans, so check the license terms before deploying.

pricing.notes: Developer plan offers a no-cost single node; Starter/Pro plans and AxonIQ Cloud for production and clustering.

scale.notes: Clustered deployments replicate contexts across nodes; multi-context allows tenant separation.

strengths: Event store and command/query routing in one component
Tight integration with Axon Framework and Spring Boot
Dynamic Consistency Boundaries in 2026.x simplify aggregate design
Snapshots and tracking processors built in
weaknesses: Practically tied to the Java Axon Framework
Licensing has shifted toward paid plans for production use
Small ecosystem outside the Axon community
useCases: Replacing a broker plus event store in Axon-based systems
notIdealFor: Teams wanting an OSI-licensed event store
